entities.summary: Matthew Tyler Murphy, known as Matt "Guitar" Murphy, was an American blues guitarist and singer-songwriter. He was associated with Memphis Slim, The Blues Brothers and Howlin' Wolf. In 2012, Murphy was elected to the Blues Hall of Fame. Matt Murphy was a composers & musicians from Sunflower (1929-12-29, Sunflower–2018-06-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
